mutants.name: assert-owner-ignored
mutants.old: if let owner, owners[k] != owner { return false }
mutants.new: if let owner, owners[k] != owner, false { return false }

mutants.name: assert-no-reown
mutants.old:
owners[k] = owner
            guard assertions[k] == nil else { return }
mutants.new:
guard assertions[k] == nil else { return }
            owners[k] = owner

mutants.name: lid-owner-ignored
mutants.new: if !on, false, !ExtensionResources.shared.ownsLidSleepDisabled(extID: extensionID, owner: owner) { return }

mutants.name: timer-owner-ignored
mutants.old: if let owner, self.owners[k] != owner { return }
mutants.new: if let owner, self.owners[k] != owner, false { return }

mutants.name: main-owner-ignored
mutants.old: guard owners[k] == owner else { return false }
mutants.new: guard owners[k] == owner || true else { return false }

mutants.name: main-teardown-keeps
mutants.old: for k in owners.keys where k.hasPrefix("\(id)\u{1}") { owners[k] = nil }
mutants.new: for k in owners.keys where k.hasPrefix("\(id)\u{1}") && false { owners[k] = nil }
